preview.title: Experience Hesaby ERP at Site and in the Office

pain.title: Contractor Bottlenecks Solved for Good
pain.p1Desc: Paper invoices get destroyed in dusty site pockets before Friday payroll. With Hesaby, snap a photo or upload a PDF; AI extracts vendor and items immediately.
pain.p2Desc: Site engineers use v3.xlsx while the office uses v5.xlsx and the bank statement matches neither. Hesaby unifies everything in real-time.
pain.p3Desc: Who authorized that 150,000 EGP cement delivery? Nobody remembers. Hesaby enforces role-based approval thresholds with immutable audit logs.
pain.p4Desc: Discovering 6 months later that your cost-plus margin collapsed. The V1.2 Profit Engine auto-transfers management fees to office revenue upon approval.

modules.title: End-to-End Control from Foundation to Final Audit
modules.m1Desc: Understands Egyptian construction dialects ('جبنا ٥٠ شكارة أسمنت') and extracts receipts or PDF invoices straight into ledger drafts.
modules.m2Title: V1.2 Office Profit Engine & Dual Safes
modules.m2Desc: Strict segregation between Project Safe and Office Safe with automated management fee allocation and margin protection.
modules.m3Desc: 14% VAT pre-calculated, bilingual branded PDFs, automated email dispatch, and partial payment tracking.
modules.m4Desc: Track daily laborers, piece-rate wages, cash advances, and subcontractor contracts with itemized statements.
modules.m5Desc: Track rebar, cement, and finishing batches delivered to each site with real-time unit costing against project BOQs.
modules.m6Desc: Upload NBE, CIB, or Banque Misr statements. Smart matching pairs thousands of transactions and flags discrepancies in seconds.
